assets.prompt: At 2x detail (two art pixels a world pixel, drawn at half size in the game) for a top-down 32x32-unit pixel game, keeping its 1x silhouette, size and frames: The Crypt Mite: a round wooden beetle, its shell split down the middle, six thin legs and a bone sting. Drawn part by part, each a rod, a ball, a bevelled box or polygon (or, for the straw, its 1x outline filled with strands): lit from the top-left in three shades of its material, the base the most, with its material's surface (wood grain along each piece, bone pores and cracks, a leaf's vein, a flame's bright core, ice streaks, glints on gold, ice and glass), a dark seam where a part lies over another and a one-pixel dark outline round the outside. Palette colours from docs/STYLE.md only; no player colours; every pixel fully clear or fully opaque.
